Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

Placements read 2026-09-16: d4builds A (2nd Barbarian in A; "HotA Furor (S15)", Rob2628, last updated 2026-09-14, showcase CbWDB7eKcG0); Maxroll Endgame A (37th of 38) and Push B (guide Last Updated 2026-09-15, planner le4dlc0q); InfinityBuilds: no Hammer of the Ancients build. Ranked above the Rend hybrid because the orchestrator's tie-break reads d4builds' in-tier order first, and d4builds lists HotA before Rend in A; on every other reference Rend has the stronger record (A on all three sites; HotA is absent from InfinityBuilds and B on Maxroll Push). Filed as theorycraft because its d4builds author writes 'Current Problems … we have to test!' about the Fury engine. Resolved disagreements: sixth skill Bash (d4builds) in late endgame vs Mighty Throw with Mightiest (Maxroll, which 'does not consume' the Red Furor bonus) in pushing; ring Stone of Jordan (Maxroll) vs legendary + Crushing Aspect (d4builds); gloves Fists of Fate (d4builds) vs legendary + Aspect of the Warpath (Maxroll); two-hander The Grandfather (d4builds) vs The Furnace + legendary Crushing (Maxroll); charms 5 Sescheron's Fury + Crown of Lucion (d4builds) vs 3 Sescheron's Fury + Blood-Mad Idol + Tuskhelm of Joritz the Mighty + Banished Lord's Talisman on Seal of the Golden Epiphany (Maxroll 'Endgame' profile). 3.2.1 context (Blizzard patch notes, read 2026-09-16): Ring of Red Furor 30-Fury threshold; Ramaladni's Magnum Opus drains 7% of Maximum Fury in combat; Melted Heart of Selig 58-77%; Aspect of the Warpath now benefits from the equipped weapon type. Soul Splinter cap caveat: the official text is 'You can equip up to three Soul Splinters among available Jewelry slots' and Leoric's Crown counts as Jewelry, yet every Season 15 reference loadout read on 2026-09-16 sockets more than three - unverified, re-verify in game [https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24295394/celebrate-30-years-of-diablo-in-season-of-hell-s-legacy - 2026-09-16].

Rotation
  1. Keep War Cry, Iron Skin and Wrath of the Berserker rolling and Rallying Cry spammed for Fury, then dump at least 30 Fury per Hammer of the Ancients so Ring of Red Furor guarantees the crit.
Variants

Leveling — War Cry, Leap and Wrath of the Berserker when available; spam Hammer of the Ancients and Rallying Cry (Maxroll, 2026-09-16).
Move on when Swap when Ring of Red Furor (The Butcher) and Tibault's Will drop — do not equip Ramaladni's Magnum Opus before Tibault's Will (Maxroll).

Early Endgame — War Cry, Iron Skin, Mighty Throw and Wrath of the Berserker when available; spam Hammer of the Ancients and Rallying Cry; spend only the minimum 30 Fury per Hammer of the Ancients (Maxroll, 2026-09-16).
Move on when Swap when you own Fists of Fate and The Grandfather and reach 40% Cooldown Reduction.

Late Endgame — Spam Rallying Cry for Fury — 'Spending Fury will be an issue' (d4builds); Bash to generate Fury; War Cry, Iron Skin and Wrath of the Berserker on cooldown; dump into Hammer of the Ancients at 30+ Fury so Ring of Red Furor guarantees the Critical Strike (d4builds, 2026-09-16).
Move on when Move to the Selig setup when Melted Heart of Selig drops and Tibault's Will plus 40% Cooldown Reduction keep your Fury bar from emptying.

Pushing — Cast War Cry, Iron Skin, Mighty Throw and Wrath of the Berserker whenever available; spam Hammer of the Ancients and Rallying Cry (Maxroll, 2026-09-16).

Plan

Maxroll planner le4dlc0q's allocation, read 2026-09-16 — identical in all four profiles; no per-node levels published. d4builds' War Plans are published only in an encoded form.

What is lit49 picks recorded on 7 of 7 activities. Everything else is dimmed, not ruled out: the trees below are the game's own 100 nodes, and a War Plan is per character.
Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

Placements read 2026-09-16: d4builds A (2nd Barbarian in A; "HotA Furor (S15)", Rob2628, last updated 2026-09-14, showcase CbWDB7eKcG0); Maxroll Endgame A (37th of 38) and Push B (guide Last Updated 2026-09-15, planner le4dlc0q); InfinityBuilds: no Hammer of the Ancients build. Ranked above the Rend hybrid because the orchestrator's tie-break reads d4builds' in-tier order first, and d4builds lists HotA before Rend in A; on every other reference Rend has the stronger record (A on all three sites; HotA is absent from InfinityBuilds and B on Maxroll Push). Filed as theorycraft because its d4builds author writes 'Current Problems … we have to test!' about the Fury engine. Resolved disagreements: sixth skill Bash (d4builds) in late endgame vs Mighty Throw with Mightiest (Maxroll, which 'does not consume' the Red Furor bonus) in pushing; ring Stone of Jordan (Maxroll) vs legendary + Crushing Aspect (d4builds); gloves Fists of Fate (d4builds) vs legendary + Aspect of the Warpath (Maxroll); two-hander The Grandfather (d4builds) vs The Furnace + legendary Crushing (Maxroll); charms 5 Sescheron's Fury + Crown of Lucion (d4builds) vs 3 Sescheron's Fury + Blood-Mad Idol + Tuskhelm of Joritz the Mighty + Banished Lord's Talisman on Seal of the Golden Epiphany (Maxroll 'Endgame' profile). 3.2.1 context (Blizzard patch notes, read 2026-09-16): Ring of Red Furor 30-Fury threshold; Ramaladni's Magnum Opus drains 7% of Maximum Fury in combat; Melted Heart of Selig 58-77%; Aspect of the Warpath now benefits from the equipped weapon type. Soul Splinter cap caveat: the official text is 'You can equip up to three Soul Splinters among available Jewelry slots' and Leoric's Crown counts as Jewelry, yet every Season 15 reference loadout read on 2026-09-16 sockets more than three - unverified, re-verify in game [https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24295394/celebrate-30-years-of-diablo-in-season-of-hell-s-legacy - 2026-09-16].

Rotation
  1. Keep War Cry, Iron Skin and Wrath of the Berserker rolling and Rallying Cry spammed for Fury, then dump at least 30 Fury per Hammer of the Ancients so Ring of Red Furor guarantees the crit.
Variants

Leveling — War Cry, Leap and Wrath of the Berserker when available; spam Hammer of the Ancients and Rallying Cry (Maxroll, 2026-09-16).
Move on when Swap when Ring of Red Furor (The Butcher) and Tibault's Will drop — do not equip Ramaladni's Magnum Opus before Tibault's Will (Maxroll).

Early Endgame — War Cry, Iron Skin, Mighty Throw and Wrath of the Berserker when available; spam Hammer of the Ancients and Rallying Cry; spend only the minimum 30 Fury per Hammer of the Ancients (Maxroll, 2026-09-16).
Move on when Swap when you own Fists of Fate and The Grandfather and reach 40% Cooldown Reduction.

Late Endgame — Spam Rallying Cry for Fury — 'Spending Fury will be an issue' (d4builds); Bash to generate Fury; War Cry, Iron Skin and Wrath of the Berserker on cooldown; dump into Hammer of the Ancients at 30+ Fury so Ring of Red Furor guarantees the Critical Strike (d4builds, 2026-09-16).
Move on when Move to the Selig setup when Melted Heart of Selig drops and Tibault's Will plus 40% Cooldown Reduction keep your Fury bar from emptying.

Pushing — Cast War Cry, Iron Skin, Mighty Throw and Wrath of the Berserker whenever available; spam Hammer of the Ancients and Rallying Cry (Maxroll, 2026-09-16).

Reasoning

HypothesisThe 3.2.1 Ring of Red Furor rework (Fury requirement 100 → 30 for a guaranteed Critical Strike, plus 1%[x] Critical Strike Damage per Fury above 30 spent, with two bug fixes) makes Hammer of the Ancients crit on every Fury dump regardless of crit chance, so the two strongest crit-penalised multipliers become free: Locran's Talisman and Abyssal Splinter of Hellfire (up to 50%[x] damage, −100% Critical Strike Chance). Both d4builds ('We play Locran's Talisman & Splinter of Hellfire but can still 100% crit with Ring of Red Furor') and Maxroll ('When paired with Locran's Talisman and Abyssal Splinter of Hellfire none of their drawbacks apply') say so. What neither has shown is a Fury engine that keeps Ramaladni's Magnum Opus (7% of Maximum Fury drained per second in combat, 3.2.1) and Wrath of the Berserker uptime alive: d4builds writes 'Bash or Frenzy or even Whirlwind we have to test!' and 'You need some Cooldown Transfigurations or else Wrath of the Berserker uptime is bad'; Maxroll uses Tibault's Will + Iron Skin (Juggernaut) + Rallying Cry (Booming) and no Basic skill. This build tests d4builds' Bash version in late endgame against Maxroll's Melted Heart of Selig version for pushing.
Confidencemedium
How to test itUntested by its own d4builds author. In game, check: (1) that Hammer of the Ancients crits 100% with Abyssal Splinter of Hellfire and Locran's Talisman equipped while spending at least 30 Fury per cast; (2) Fury over a 60-second pack fight with Bash (Fury Generation, Clobbering) versus Maxroll's no-Basic Tibault's Will loop — if the Fury bar empties, Ramaladni's multiplier collapses; (3) Wrath of the Berserker uptime at 40-45% Cooldown Reduction (Maxroll's target); (4) Toughness with only Abyssal Splinter of Pain (d4builds: 'Hope Toughness is fine'); (5) whether Crown of Lucion as a charm (d4builds) hurts the combo — Maxroll says Resource Cost Reduction 'would negatively impact the Ring of Red Furor combos'; (6) Melted Heart of Selig at 58-77% (3.2.1 cut) with Life stripped from gear, per Maxroll's Selig profile.

late_endgame loadout (d4builds HotA Furor (S15), read 2026-09-16). Seal with Critical Strike Damage and Attack Speed while Berserking (d4builds; name not given). Charm stat: Martial Skill ranks. d4builds: 'Berserk Crucible or Sescheron Set both work!' Other stages (Maxroll planner le4dlc0q): leveling 'Starter' — Legendary Horadric Seal (Critical Strike Damage); Phoba, Berú, Mlor, Fer, Linta of Sescheron's Fury. early_endgame 'Midgame' — Legendary Horadric Seal; Phoba, Berú, Mlor, Fer, Linta of Sescheron's Fury + Banished Lord's Talisman. Maxroll's 'Endgame' profile (not used for this site's late_endgame charms) — Seal of the Golden Epiphany; Phoba, Mlor, Fer of Sescheron's Fury + Blood-Mad Idol, Tuskhelm of Joritz the Mighty, Banished Lord's Talisman. pushing 'Endgame (Selig)' — Seal of the Golden Epiphany; Phoba, Mlor, Fer of the Crucible + Blood-Mad Idol, Banished Lord's Talisman, Locran's Talisman. Maxroll warns Resource Cost Reduction 'would negatively impact the Ring of Red Furor combos' — relevant to Crown of Lucion.

Ring of Red Furor

Unique Ring

  • After spending 30 Fury within 5 seconds, your next non-Channeled Core or Weapon Mastery Skill Cast within 5 seconds is a guaranteed Critical Strike and deals 50 – 60% bonus Critical Strike Damage. Excess Fury grants 1%[x] additional bonus.

"Anger brings strength but clouds the mind. You must learn to focus your fury, direct it with purpose. Keep our sacred duty at the forefront of your mind, always." - Talic, to Madawc

Unique Pants

"The younger apprentices think wearing heavy plate in the swamps is foolish. They fail to understand that our armor is our legacy, and without it we are nothing." - Crusader Pembroke

"Will you let fear cheat you, or will you risk everything to find understanding? After all, death is simply the coin with which we purchase life." - Zurke

Unique Amulet

A single petal of the Mother's own blood, slowly wilting under glass.

Endurant Faith

Unique Gloves

  • When you would be damaged for at least 30% of your Maximum Life at once, it is instead distributed over the next 4 seconds and reduced by 15 – 20%.

Despite the Light's blessings, countless Knights Penitent were hewn apart by the infernal hordes. Remnants of their steel lie scattered through the Hells – dwindling lights in the chaos.

Banished Lord's Talisman

Unique Amulet

  • After you spend 275 of your Primary Resource, gain 4 stacks of Overpower. Consuming Overpower increases your Critical Strikes damage by 87 – 100% for 8 seconds.

"His name has been lost to history, but to have been exiled from a land as cursed as Hawezar, his deeds must have been truly depraved." - Scholar's Notes

Blood-Mad Idol

Unique Amulet

  • You are always Berserking but take 200%[x] increased damage as Burning over 8 seconds. While Burning, Berserking grants an additional 80 – 100% increased damage.

An unbroken lineage of unwavering strength.

Melted Heart of Selig

Mythic Unique Amulet

  • Damage is dealt to your Primary Resource before Life and damage taken this way is drastically reduced.
  • Your Primary Resource is doubled but Maximum Life is reduced by 75%.

"Do not allow your passions to become obsessions. Fuel the fire that burns within you, but it is madness to allow yourself to become ash to please an uncaring universe." - Last words of Master Selig

Requires Level 35
